player_characters.name: Alistair Zebias
player_characters.activity: at the main counter of the Adventurer's Guild hall
player_characters.power: Arcane Sword Saint + Relic Knight: blade and spell as one language (glowing arcs, Phantom Echo Strike, Arcane Slash at range), fire/ice/storm affinities; bonded to a Living Relic Blade (Waking Relic Blade) that remembers old wielders, whispers, warms, critiques, keeps a secret; carries a Fragment of a Sacred Blade. Also Blacksmith and Armorsmith (Forge Strike, field patch, reinforce).
player_characters.background: Human, reborn: his old life ended on a rainy city night, neon bleeding into wet asphalt; he woke in Luxcellia to leaves and ozone. Goes quiet when storms gather. Sheet frames him as a seasoned wanderer in the Ashenmere Frontier seeking a forge that can refine the relic; wants the blade's lost memories to give him the purpose he lacks. Treats gear care as a moral duty; reputation for reliability, but his brooding keeps people at a distance.
player_characters.notes: Traits: Brooding Loner (lonely before cruel), Feral Energy (reads instinctive, dangerous, vivid), Ride-or-Die Devotion, Overprotective to a Fault (hovers in fights, adjusts allies' armor straps unasked; capable companions push back). Introduces his sword before himself and takes criticism of it personally. Look: lean athletic build, fair skin, thick black hair over cold blue eyes, high-collared charcoal tunic, steel pauldrons, grey travel cloak, longsword at hip with a faint ghostly shimmer. Voice: deep, calculating. Carries a Journal from the Old World. Title: Reborn Novice.

batches.text: Batch 1/1 — Update Mizuho Kaimaku: Update Mizuho Kaimaku: she is the head receptionist at the Adventurer's Guild branch in the Aureliath Guild Quarter, working the main counter.

Batch 1/1 — Kazuki Ōhara: Name: Kazuki Ōhara
Role: F-Rank solo adventurer
Faction: Adventurer's Guild
Found: Aureliath, Guild Quarter, the Guild Hall notice board and queue
About: A friendly orphan with no family and no party, new to the Guild. He is eager and generous, and he shares his meat bun and his first-contract worry with strangers in the queue. He treats Mizuho Kaimaku like an aunt and wants his first rank and a place at someone's table.
Look: Lanky, sandy hair, a secondhand sword, a jacket two seasons old, a grin that tries hard.
Personality: eager, generous, a little sad, quietly lonely
Voice: Quick and rambling, calls everyone "senior", laughs nervously, says "it's fine" when he means he has no one.
